Theme

Latin word

multum

adverb; with a genitive, a lot of

a lot, much; often

In this lexicon

  • a lot

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 50.2: multum lūsimus; Cic. Att. 8.13.2: multum mēcum mūnicipālēs hominēs loquuntur (Lewis & Short); Traupman 85: multum temporis

  • multum posse (valēre) apud: influence

    classical

  • somnum in multum diem prōdūcere: sleep in

    modern

Examples

  • hesternō, Licinī, diē ōtiōsī multum lūsimus in meīs tabellīs

    yesterday, Licinius, with time on our hands, we played a lot on my writing tabletsCatull. 50.1–2

    In the entry for a lot

  • vīlla mihi valdē placuit

    I liked the house a lotCic. Q. fr. 3.1.1
